title: Pack, package and other Markdown are not graphed
text: The live docs graph on 2026-10-17 has no tracked Markdown page outside an area or an explicitly ungraphed pattern. docs/public/* already includes the nested public corpus, so docs-graph.json needs no change. Pack, package-internal, learning, brand, event and packaging Markdown remain explicitly ungraphed with reasons; do not infer topic completeness, installed delivery or live usefulness from area membership. JOURNEYS owns deeper topic coverage only after each remaining need has a direct home or its own evidenced gap.
owner: JOURNEYS documentation depth; each Pack owns its guidance
